title: Overlaps tab crashes with a raw JS error when overlap_statistics.single_source_genes is absent
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/sheet-dashboard.png: all 4 configs show "Chart failed to render. Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLocaleString')". Cause in this env: the :8000 backend was started 16:22, before c61676a (17:15) added single_source_genes; with the field injected (dash-overlaps-patched.png) the UpSet renders correctly.
impact: Any frontend/backend version skew (rolling deploy, cached API, MCP snapshot) blanks the default dashboard tab and shows an internal exception string to users. The Pydantic OverlapStatistics schema also lacks single_source_genes, so a response_model would strip it.
fix: Guard the stat (value ?? null, render "—"), add single_source_genes to OverlapStatistics, and have ErrorBoundary show a plain message (keep err.message in console/logService only).

title: HPO evidence card still lists 17 of 41 HNF1B terms as bare HP IDs
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/crop-exp-l2.png: after "Ureteropelvic junction obstruction" the list continues HP:0000069, HP:0000071 ... HP:0100542 with no names.
impact: Names come only from hpo_term_details or the gene HPO annotation; terms in neither render as codes, so the original bug is only partly fixed.
fix: Resolve missing names from the HPO ontology/annotation term table (backend), or at minimum store names in evidence_data at ingest; OntologyTermList should never fall back to a bare ID without a tooltip saying the name is unavailable.

title: Dates are formatted four different ways across views
evidence: Home "15 Mar 2026" (en-GB), Data Sources "2026-03-15" (en-CA), evidence/profile "Mar 15, 2026" (en-US), admin pipeline/staging/logs/cache "3/15/2026, 1:41:12 PM" (locale default).
impact: Breaks the "same thing looks the same everywhere" rule; locale-default M/D/Y is ambiguous for European users.
fix: One utils/formatDate (date + datetime) used everywhere; ISO or "15 Mar 2026" consistently.

title: Frontend error reporting posts to /client-logs (missing /api prefix) and 404s
evidence: Console: "Failed to load resource: 404" on /genes, /data-sources, /dashboard; network shows POST http://127.0.0.1:5199/client-logs 404. Backend route is /api/client-logs (backend/app/main.py:331).
impact: Client errors never reach the backend log viewer and every reported warning adds console noise.
fix: Post to `${apiBase}/api/client-logs`, matching the axios clients (src/api/*.ts use /api/... paths).

title: MONDO empty state says "No MONDO disease mapping for this gene yet" while evidence cards on the same page show MONDO:0007669
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/hnf1b-evidence-collapsed-light.png + crop-exp-d0.png. Component is sound (DataState loading/error/empty, OntologyTerm, sorted/deduped source IDs); local DB has no mondo annotation for HNF1B.
impact: Reads as a contradiction to a geneticist; it cannot distinguish "annotation not run" from "no mapping".
fix: When annotations.mondo is absent say "MONDO mapping has not been computed for this gene"; keep the current text for an empty mondo_diseases list.

title: Step-number badges in Filter/Build/Cluster buttons are 10px at 3.7:1
impact: Below 12px data minimum and AA text contrast.
fix: text-xs and full-opacity foreground on the badge, or drop the number in favour of the stepper label.

title: Gene-structure plot labels (exon numbers, scale bar, coordinates) are 10px; "|" separators at 1.8-2.0:1
evidence: Probe tinyText 46@10px, 15@10px, "4 kb"@10px, chr16:...@10px; lowContrast 1.82:1 for text-muted-foreground/40 separators.
impact: Hard to read at research density; mobile plot needs sideways scroll (stated) and title is clipped ("PKD1 - E").
fix: Use 12px for axis/scale text; use a full-strength separator or a gap.

title: HGNC ID cells are links but render as plain foreground monospace, unlike gene-symbol links
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/crop-genes.png: HGNC:7907 etc. black mono; smallTargets lists them as a[href] 65x19.
impact: Users do not discover the HGNC link; 19px tall target.
fix: Give OntologyTerm links the primary/underline-on-hover treatment used for gene symbols.

title: Tables scroll horizontally inside their card at 390px with no visible cue; tier chip and columns cut at the edge
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/sheet-genes.png (mobile: "Comprehensive Supp…" cut), grid-mobile.png (users Email, logs Message, staging Expert review cut). Page overflow is 0 everywhere.

title: Method, Path, Status and Duration columns are empty for almost all rows (carried over)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/grid-admin-light.png (System Logs): only Message has content; rows dominated by "Request started"/"Request completed".
impact: Wasted width; request noise buries the 25 errors in 24h.
fix: Populate from structured log fields or hide empty columns; default filter to WARNING+.

title: Every source shows "Completed 3/15/2026" seven months ago with no staleness signal (carried over)
impact: Admins cannot see that data is stale.
fix: Show relative age and a warning status beyond the source update interval.

title: Only the 200 highest-priority of 402 pending items are reachable (stated, backend has no offset)
evidence: Copy: "The 200 highest-priority of 402 pending items are loaded; reviewing them brings the next ones in."
impact: Search/filter cannot find items outside the first 200.
fix: Add offset/search to the staging API and page server-side.

title: PanelApp "Rating and inheritance" shows raw upper-case API strings
impact: Inconsistent with "Autosomal dominant" wording in GenCC/ClinGen cards.
fix: Map PanelApp MOI strings to the shared inheritance vocabulary (keep raw value in a tooltip).

title: Diagnostic panels card lists panel names without provider/lab and has no source link in the footer
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/reaudit/crop-exp-l2.png: "CentoNephro", "Renasight"... no lab; footer only "Last updated". Data Sources says "1 Provider" for 32 panels.
impact: Provenance (which lab) is a product requirement; card anatomy differs from the six others (no footer link).
fix: Carry provider per panel through ingest and show "Panel · Lab"; link to the panel URL when known.
